scripts.dev: npm run icons && python3 scripts/build_sidecar.py --development && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run icons && python3 scripts/build_sidecar.py && tauri build
scripts.build:e2e: npm run icons && python3 scripts/build_sidecar.py --development && tauri build --debug --no-bundle --features desktop-e2e
scripts.check: npm run icons && python3 scripts/build_sidecar.py --placeholder && npm run build:web && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
